bias.zh: 中性 · 再度受阻于 $150，守住 $145

read.en: SpaceX rose 1.1% on Oct 27 to $148.58, trading between $146.63 and $151.35, with no 100-day average yet (95 sessions). It is just below the rising 5-day ($149.4) and falling 10-day ($149.0) averages, and below the rising 30-day ($153.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($166.09), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月27日上涨 1.1%，收于 $148.58，盘中区间 $146.63–151.35；上市仅 95 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$149.4）和下行的 10 日均线（$149.0），低于上行的 30 日均线（$153.5）。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$166.09），RSI 为 48。

read.en: A push to $151.4 faded again under $150; no level changed. Resistance is $149–150 (5 and 10-day, round number), then $153.5–154.3 (30-day, Oct 22 high) and $166.1–166.2 (SAR, Oct 21 high). Support is $146.6 (Oct 27 low), then $144.6–145.4 (Oct 26 and Sep 28 lows) and $142.9–143.2. A close above $151.4 would target $153.5–154; a close below $144.6 would open $143.
